probe.convergence: a fit converges when n_iter_ < max_iter, no ConvergenceWarning is raised and the maximum absolute gradient of the training objective at the fitted parameters, computed independently of scikit-learn, is at most gradient_tolerance
probe.max_iter_rule: max_iter = 2000 unless the blinded benchmark records a non-converged fit at 2000 and every fit converges at 5000, in which case 5000; no other value and no retry
probe.non_convergence: the replicate is FAILED; nothing is retried or changed
probe.objective: mean multinomial (or binary) log-loss over the training fold plus ||W||^2 / (2 C n_train); the intercept is not penalised

reference_scenario.C: C_task and C_twin means measured by the pipeline-faithful check with the synthetic model accuracy set to the published 0.5144 (autond_ce1/AutoND-upstream/README.md line 181 (pinned upstream commit 8d66e0a43a9e6fbbb3624d68296c1b77aa2da779): 0.5144 +- 0.0003)
reference_scenario.S1_S2: population-level: the synthetic target carries an oracle balanced-accuracy effect of SESOI = 0.005 (prospective judgment) and the twin none; the S1 and S2 means used are the probe endpoint means measured by the pipeline-faithful check at each n, so the n-dependent loss from estimating the probe is included
reference_scenario.noise: within-replicate SDs from the pipeline-faithful check, inflated to their one-sided 95% upper chi-square bound

report: AutoND CE3 power: pipeline-faithful noise calibration and joint fixed-sequence power

selection.b_rule: B odd, so that the S1 sign is exactly symmetric under the permutation null; the smallest B in {5, 11, 21} whose P(SUPPORTED) at the reference scenario is within 0.01 of B = 21 and whose lower bound still meets the n rule
selection.n_rule: the smallest n in {50000, 100000, 200000} whose one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound for P(SUPPORTED) is at least 0.90 at the reference scenario of the power evidence; if none qualifies the design is not frozen

supersedes.reason: draft 1 fixed the S1 and S2 endpoint means at SESOI for every n, ignoring the n-dependent loss from estimating the probe that its own pipeline-faithful check measured; that favours small n and selected 50000. This analysis uses the same pipeline-faithful replicates (not re-run) with the measured endpoint means at a population-level oracle effect of SESOI.

synthetic_model: 64 ReLU features relu(G M) with Gaussian G and a random mixing matrix M; the target class is an ordinal coarsening of a noisy linear score of the features with the P1 class fractions; the twin is an independent signal-free ReLU representation; the calibration labels follow a logistic model in a linear score of the features whose sign rule reaches the published accuracy; the CE3 fold, permutation and probe code is run unchanged
